title: svgif motion preset
description: One reusable animation block. Track frames are integer offsets from the moment the block is applied to one node. Applying the block writes those keys onto that node's tracks. This document is not a second timeline. The sampled composition stays the tracks on that node. adr:svgif/20261110173419.

tracks.description: Frames are relative to the apply moment. Frame 0 is that moment.

property.description: filter.x, filter.y, filter.width, and filter.height set those attributes on the filter element. filter.<primitive>.<attribute> sets that attribute on the primitive. Any other filter-element name is rejected.

layer.description: Artwork layer id on the component. Absent means the first layer. This is not a top-level preset field.

frame.description: Offset from the moment this block is applied to one node.
